|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 5) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Stardust (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V9-L-Stardust-2020-10-14-d5f24d6.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V9-L-Stardust-2020-10-14-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V9-L-Stardust-original-2018-07-08-022435b.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V9-L-Stardust-2020-10-14-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V9-L-Stardust-2020-10-14-d5f24d6.gif]], 14 October 2020).
* '''Original''' ([[Stardust]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-stardust022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/stardust.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Light/large/stardust.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Portable Scanner”. Text: “Deploy on Data Vault. At any time, may relocate Stardust to your spy present. During your control phase, if on your spy at a battleground you occupy, opponent loses 2 Force. If about to leave table, relocate to Data Vault (if possible). [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 14 October 2020<ref name="img-stardustd5f24d6">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/stardust.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d5f24d6dd023e0aba39bc2f530e19465496ebf25 commit d5f24d6] (14 October 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Light/large/stardust.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Portable Scanner”. Text: “Deploy on Data Vault. At any time, may relocate Stardust to your spy present.
